verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that users can leave by deleting their Shortwave account, which implies some account-level deletion. No documentation describes retention settings or selective data controls, and another user wished for a denylist to keep sensitive mail from syncing to Shortwave's servers. missing for 10: first-party documentation of account/data deletion, user-configurable retention periods, selective exclusion of mail from server sync, deletion of AI-processed data, independent corroboration.
